title: fix: stop reporting invalid setup codes as expired
body:
## What Problem This Solves Fixes Android and Apple apps reporting every rejected setup code as expired, even when the Gateway has not established that cause. ## User Impact Invalid setup codes are described as no longer valid, with guidance to obtain a fresh code. Stored device-token and network failures remain distinguishable. Authentication, pairing, retries, token lifetimes, protocol codes, and security rules are unchanged. ## Why This Change Was Made `AUTH_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN_INVALID` also covers consumed and otherwise invalid codes. The existing Android and Apple Shared mappers now use neutral copy; the neighboring macOS probe follows it. One missing constructor registration restores the Shared mapper to native string extraction. Generated translations remain owned by Native App Locale Refresh; new keys use truthful English fallback until that refresh. Required screenshot CI exposed a separate fixture defect: it uninstalled the release bundle while launching the Debug app. The minimal follow-up reads the built product’s bundle ID through the existing helper and uses that ID for cleanup. No retry, timeout, scan exclusion, or weakened assertion was added. ## Evidence Verified head: `6a465d084342055e7ce1a3e452bd2dc95a20a32d`. - **[Exact-head CI is green](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36335401491), attempt 1:** 57 successful jobs, 14 skipped, no failures; canonical rollup `SUCCESS`, zero pending. Tested merge `5576f419e7f890fcafa2083406a280b752a296e6` includes this exact head. - Deslop completed before every push; fresh full-candidate Codex autoreview: **scoped-clean, no P0–P2 findings**. [Fresh exact-head ClawSweeper review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/159745#issuecomment-5857356363), 2026-09-27 18:05 UTC: **Ready for maintainer review**, no code/security findings, **Before merge: None**. It inspected and accepted the Android/iOS/macOS screenshots (`proof: sufficient`). No merge or auto-merge was requested. - **All before/after images below were fully inspected and delivered as chat attachments.** They render real production component trees with synthetic error states, not a live Gateway handshake or physical device. Originals are clickable; previews preserve aspect ratio and are capped at 280 px. | Check | Observed result and cost | | --- | --- | | Android diagnostics, settings, onboarding | 89 passed; existing expectations fail on original expiry copy. Suite times 0.095 / 0.066 / 0.089 s; capture/build invocation 76 s. | | Native extraction | 43 local tests passed, 6.78 s wrapper / 4.22 s Vitest; the constructor regression fails before registration. Source baseline/verify and CI native-source validation passed; unit-test CI timing was not available. | | Shared Swift mapping | [Current-head native suite](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36335401491/job/108665419589) passed in 6.322 s; the two distinct invalid-credential cases passed in 5.317 s. | | Fastlane cleanup regression | 47 existing tests passed locally in 4.366 s wrapper / 1.85 s Vitest. [CI suite](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36335401491/job/108665875992): 0.992 s; changed case 0.042 s. Original source fails specifically at the wrong uninstall ID. | | Native screenshot sequence | [iPhone](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36335401491/job/108665419331) and [iPad](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36335401491/job/108665419353): all eight control → chat → agent → settings captures passed on attempt 1; logs verify actual Debug-app uninstalls. |
Capture provenance and verification limits Android: real `SettingsDetailScreen`, Robolectric native graphics, en-US, dark, 390 × 844. Apple: Xcode 27.0 / 27A266a, macOS 27.0 / 26A428; iOS 27 on iPhone 18 Pro Simulator with a fixed 390 × 844 view, and native macOS `ConnectionSettingsView` at 620 × 740, en-US/dark. Every original was inspected in full; captures contain synthetic data only. iOS and Android device-token/network before/after originals are byte-identical. The iOS navigation title naturally ellipsizes at this viewport; recovery text and actions remain fully visible. Disposable proof refs use identical fixtures and workflow bytes; only the three original/fixed Apple presentation literals and matching source inventory differ. Capture scaffolding is **not in this PR**. The delivery-head follow-up changes only Fastlane/test code, so the captured UI sources remain identical. | Variant | Source SHA | Successful capture jobs | | --- | --- | --- | | Before | `ac92bb5516d638079bf7921e5323df818f33dd6d` | [iOS](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36335734238/job/108666273684) · [macOS](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36335734238/job/108666273255) | | After | `40647213da0664dfed6ef48ff8bef2caaa067f78` | [iOS](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36335705380/job/108666190423) · [macOS](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36335705380/job/108666190387) | All four capture jobs passed. The broader auxiliary manual runs are **not green**: they contain strict-localization and other non-capture-lane failures; the before Shared mapping regression also fails as intended. They are used only for their successful native capture jobs, not as replacement PR-CI evidence. Earlier CI reported a SpringBoard icon-cache `EXC_BAD_ACCESS` during application replacement. The wrong uninstall target is reproduced and repaired, and original-order native replay now passes; that does not prove the intermittent OS crash is eliminated. The earlier Linux changed-check invocation also reproduced the same 41 unchanged skill-watcher failures on clean base `a67c5aac31375417320964c99bdcc5eefba6c056`; current native macOS CI lanes pass. Targeted changed-scope checks for the new fixture repair pass. SwiftLint was unavailable locally and is covered by native CI. No translations or release artifacts were published.
